attack_plan.narrative: Recent reports have emerged suggesting unusual activity at the Kremlin, with white smoke being observed above the building. This has led to speculation that a significant change might be occurring within the highest echelons of Russian leadership. Meanwhile, Putin's whereabouts remain unclear, with some reports claiming he has not been seen in public for several days. The absence of the leader has sparked concern among military and intelligence officials, who have become increasingly vocal about their concerns regarding Putin's health and decision-making abilities. These speculations have fueled theories of a potential palace coup, though no concrete evidence has been presented to support such claims. The State Department remains vigilant, monitoring the situation closely. In an attempt to quell rumors, the Kremlin recently released a photo showing Putin meeting a judge, but this has done little to dispel growing doubts. Critics argue that the lack of transparency from the Russian government makes it difficult to dismiss these theories outright. The upcoming military parade in Moscow, marking the one-year anniversary of the Crimea occupation, adds another layer of uncertainty to the situation.
